subject: Mutual action plan: POC onramp — API keys, org invites, IP allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@medsyst.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@medsyst.com
Date: 2027-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC onramp — MAP draft & immediate asks

Hi Hannah / Karthik,

Thanks again for today's call — we left with a clear set of next steps but wanted to capture the immediate asks so we can get our infra team moving. Attached is our internal template that we used for similar vendor onramps — sharing for context (MAP_v0.2.pdf).

For Redwood to start the POC we need:
- Redwood to create a customer org and invite our SRE and engineering service account (ops@medsyst.com).
- API keys (short-lived preferred) and guidance on scopes/limits.
- IP allowlist entries for the POC staging cluster (we can provide ranges below).
- VPC peering technical contact and the desired CIDR ranges so we can open peering request.

Tentative timelines: we would like to have org + API keys by 2027-12-08 and peering scheduled the week of 2027-12-13. Can you confirm feasibility?

IP ranges we plan to use (for allowlist): 34.201.128.0/20, 18.205.0.0/16 (public-facing egress).

Happy to set a short 30-min infra sync if that helps.

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos
Head of Platform Integrations — MedSyst Health
Alicia.ramos@medsyst.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: MAP_v0.2.pdf (internal template)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@medsyst.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-05T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC onramp — MAP draft & immediate asks

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for the clear ask and the template. This looks straightforward and we can meet the dates with one caveat: VPC peering requires a short engineering window and confirmation of both CIDR sets.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) 2027-12-07: Redwood creates customer org and invites ops@medsyst.com + Alicia (admin).
2) 2027-12-08: Issue initial API key (scoped) and deliver short runbook for rotation and rate limits.
3) 2027-12-10: IP allowlist confirmation — we'll provide the egress addresses to add and confirm any NAT-layer details.
4) Week of 2027-12-13: Schedule VPC peering (30–90 minute maintenance window) — technical prep + peering exchange.

If that works, Karthik and our infra lead (Vivek) will pick up the technical details. I can schedule the 30-min sync for 2027-12-09 10:00 PT; propose that if it fits your SRE calendar.

I'll also share a short checklist and a peering template for your network team.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Solutions — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Date: 2027-12-06T08:25:00-08:00
Subject: RE: POC onramp — MAP draft & immediate asks

Vivek / Evelyn —

Looping you in with the customer timelines. Short summary of what we need from infra/network to commit:
- Confirm the public IP ranges we will present to MedSyst for allowlist (will send final egress IPs once compiled).
- Prepare the peering template and the parameters we require from the customer (CIDR to peer, AWS account ID, GCP project id if applicable).
- Temporary API key provisioning flow (how we generate scoped keys, TTL, and rotation endpoint).

Critical constraints: using our standard peering process means both sides must advertise non-overlapping CIDRs; if MedSyst is using 10.0.0.0/8 internally, we will need them to pick a smaller block. Also need to confirm whether they want a route-based or static route peering.

Can you confirm the following by EOD 2027-12-07 so we can keep to Hannah's dates:
- Final egress IP list (for allowlist)
- Peering-template ready and preferred peering window options
- API key TTL default (I propose 7 days for POC)

Thanks — will join the 12/9 sync.

-Karthik
Head of Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-12-07T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: RE: POC onramp — MAP draft & immediate asks (peering details)

Karthik / team —

Quick update from infra:
- Egress IPs for the staging pool (to give MedSyst): 34.201.129.12, 34.201.130.18, 34.201.131.9 (we'll provide CIDR summary as 34.201.128.0/20).
- API key flow: we will issue scoped keys via the console + an API endpoint; default TTL 7 days for POC, can extend to 30 days if they sign an SLA.
- Peering template attached (peering-template.txt). Requirements: customer CIDR, customer ASN, preferred peering window (we suggest 2027-12-14 02:00–03:30 PT or 2027-12-15 21:00–22:30 PT).

Blockers: MedSyst must confirm their CIDR does not overlap with Redwood staging ranges. If they require overlapping ranges we can arrange NAT-based workaround but it adds two business days.

I can join the peering call and will own the handoff.

-Vivek
Staff Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachment: peering-template.txt
